hml.text: Feroz comes across Ulgrotha, a plane ruined by the Wizards' Wars, and at the last unspoiled oasis he meets and marries Serra.
Together they work to restore the plane and create Feroz's Ban, a magical barrier cast over the world to guard it from planeswalkers, and he founds the Wizards' School.
When Taysir follows Sandruu to Ulgrotha and exiles him, Feroz defeats and kills Taysir, though the Spiritcrafters later revive Taysir as an ally.
Feroz then dies in a laboratory accident, and the grief-stricken Serra, manipulated by Baron Sengir, leaves the plane, so the ban begins to fail.
